title: Parker Loves the Duck Chew....
text: Bought the Barkbox for the Swagbucks points on the Barkbox site for my Parker. The toys were sure a surprise and not attractive. Parker loves the duck chew but it makes awful stains. He did not like the other treats. I would probably continue to buy toys from Bark but besides getting the points, this wasn’t worth the price unfortunately.
label: neutral
